headline: STICK WALK walks the studio floor
lede: A 31-joint mocap-layout figure with a procedural gait — weight shift, arm swing, and feet that plant without a millimetre of measured slip — is live in the demos, along with a 47-gate harness that proves the promise can fail. Main is green again after the nightly's missileplay flake was root-caused and fixed.

notes.text: STICK WALK shipped (#1150): Froude-gated walk/run, world-frozen stance contacts solved by IK, orbit camera, attract autopilot, phone pad, synthesized footsteps — resumed from a dead session's half-built corpse and finished in one shift.

The #601 merge freeze is lifted: the nightly missileplay failure was the DEV quiet-stage auto-clearing its own wave on slow CI frames, wiping planted warheads. QA's sentinel-queue fix (#1176) merged; a second independent fix closed redundant; nightly rerun green.

Silent-NaN trio, now in the record: sim.pos is [x,z] (center[2] = undefined erased the grid and body shadow), lines crossing the near plane must be clipped not dropped, and bone widths must come from metres x focal/z — fixed constants drew 68px bones.
stickwalkcheck: 47 gates including sprite-matches-state pixel probes at three camera views, 0 mm slip at 0.4–5 m/s, and a proven-fail contact-ride mutant that turns the slip gates red.
